N-terminal half performs the 3-prime incision and C-terminal half performs the 5-prime incision of DNA lesions.
Annotated as cytoplasmic, DNA-binding, and part of the excinuclease repair complex; interacts with UvrB.
Associated biological processes include nucleotide-excision repair and SOS response.
